scope: File identity, 16-D array headers, metadata, completion and source pointers; not a rerun of the scientific experiment.
research_log_section: ## T39 — O1 큰 N: E0 (VLA 단독) 대 E3b (AG3S + cuRobo ESDF + TO, gate · HOLD) 를 같은 noise 로 짝지어 (2026-10-02)
limitations: Only recorded task outcomes for the T39 snapshot and clear-scene test episodes are registered.
No collision-rate, safe-success, full-body safety, grounding accuracy, latency or real-robot evidence is registered here.
The reported exact McNemar p-value does not establish equivalence or non-inferiority.
Two seeds from an episode are nested observations, not independent task instances.
The test split label is recorded metadata; independence from training/tuning has not been audited.
Checkpoint identity is recorded from the execution config; a content hash of the model weights has not been audited.
Physical contacts and geometry have not been recomputed in this paper setup step.
